params.prompt: Photorealistic restaurant menu food photograph, overhead view. Six small clear 2-ounce portion cups arranged in a neat row: chunky guacamole, white garlic sauce, tzatziki with cucumber, fresh pico de gallo, orange chipotle aioli, and bright pink pickled red onions. The food sits on the red-painted wooden counter of a walk-up food stand in Los Angeles. Bright natural afternoon sunlight with crisp soft shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field; background softly blurred warm red and brick tones with a hint of colorful cut-paper banners. Tack-sharp focus, true-to-life textures and natural color, appetizing but not over-styled. No text, no logos, no labels, no people, no hands.
